pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Adds Native 2D Sprite Atlas, Sprite Animation, Tile Set, and Tile Map parity to the existing typed-document CLI and headless MCP host. The adapters reuse the canonical TypedDocumentAuthoringService, document validators, revision/generation checks, and canonical persistence while exposing explicit headless selection flags for the same four document families.

This continues ADR0127 first-release completion on the current-main synchronized task branch.
